critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the upper-deck hump primitive by increasing its longitudinal length along the fuselage axis until it covers 75% of the main deck's top surface. Simultaneously, apply a fillet radius to the junction where the hump meets the main fuselage to smooth the transition angle from sharp to curved. Finally, increase the vertical offset (Z-axis) of this primitive by 15% relative to the main deck line to create a distinct 'second story' appearance.

discrepancies.observed: The upper-deck hump ends abruptly near the front of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The hump extends significantly further back along the top of the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length along the longitudinal axis

discrepancies.observed: A sharp, angular transition where the upper deck meets the main fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous aerodynamic curve blending into the main body.

discrepancies.observed: The nose is a flat, vertical cylinder face.
discrepancies.reference: A rounded, convex aerodynamic nose cone.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: replace flat face with a spherical cap or rounded geometry

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears too low and integrated into the main fuselage diameter.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct, elevated second story that sits clearly above the main deck line.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase vertical offset of the upper-deck primitive
